rnams kyang 'jig rten gyi khams ga ge mo zhig ces bya ba zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhig sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang 0)yongs su dag par byed do zhes (miched du brjod pa ched du brjod pa cing bsngags pa yang gsung la ming yang yongs su sgrogs shing / byang chub sems dpa' de'i sgra rjod pa yang mdzad la/ dbyangs rjes su sgrogs pa yang mdzad do/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa④/tshe dang ldan pa gang po ji tshabatsam gyis na(kha/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang yin/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i ⑦bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing / de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa na 'dod pa dag las dben pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par byas te gnas pa dang / de bzhin du bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa rdzogs par byas te gnas pa dang / de 98༄byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa rgya chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa/ khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu khyab par byas te gnas pa dang / de bzhin du snying rje dang ldan pa dang /dga' ba dang ldan pa dang / btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa rgya 29—302

chen por ①gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa/ khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu khyab par byas te gnas pa dang / de bzhin du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched dang / ci yang med pa'i skye mched dang /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched rdzogs par byas te/ gnas pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ri bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad med pa rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams te/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa gang gi tshe/ nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / rtags dang / mtshan ma rnams kyis bsam gtan de dag dang / tshad med pa de dag dang / gzugs med pa de dag la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang ba na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas ci/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ri bar byed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa la yang gong ma bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ bsam gtan bzhi 55skadang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi po dag la snyoms par 'jug ste/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan de dag dang / tshad med pa de dag dang / gzugs med 29—303

pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis gnas shing / de bsam gtan dang /tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la snyoms par 'jug la ldang ba na/ nam mkha'i rnam pa dang / rtags dang / mtshan ma rnams yid la byed de/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag dang / gzhan dag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ①bar byed do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa/ khon med pal/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis aklas pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs gcig khyab par byas te gnas shing / phyogs bcu'i bar du khyab par byas te gnas pa dang / snying rje dang ldan pa dang / dga' ba dang ldan pa yang de bzhin te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po btang pu snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa/ rgya chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa/ khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa / gnod pa med pa/ shin tu bsgoms ④pas 'jig rten chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs pa'i phyogs bcu'i phyogs re 29wa 304

re khyab par byas nas gnas pa de hu)ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya'o/ /yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa bsal ba'i phyir bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gzhan dag la yang rjod cing ston te rab tu 'chad la/ rnam par 'byed de gsal ②bar byed cing / de dag gi ro myong (kyeb dang / nyes dmigs dang / nges par 'byung ba yang tshul bzhin du ston pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba de dag nyid kyis bsam gtan dang po dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar dag ④gnon cing sgom ( ste/bsam gtan dang po dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa'i bar de la yang gnas la 'di lta ste/ nyan thos kyi sems sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa gzhan dag gi skabs mi 'byed pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nag nog med pa'o//byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis gnas pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zad par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to snyam nas ⑥yid la byed pa de dag la 'dod pa dang / bzod pa dang / yongs su rtog ⑦pa dang / khong du chud par byed pa dang / nye bar nges par sems pa gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu 29—305

phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngo zhing / brtson 'grus kyang mi gtong ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang yang nyan thos kyi sa'am/rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yang mi lhung zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag rnams dang / bsam gtan gnyis pa dang /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i yan lag rnams la mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang /sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa'i rnam pa dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par so sor rtog pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 0)pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi theg pa chen 29—306

po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po nyunyernam pa thams cad du byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sgom ②pa dang / rnam pa thams cad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / ji mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom (dadapa dang / rnam pa thams cad du stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag sgom ④pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' gachen po byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug cing / bdag gis sems can thams cad bskyab bo zhes mngon par gzhol bar byed pa dang /snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug cing / sems can rnams la snying rje ba dang / snying brtse bar nges par gzhol ba dang / dga' ba'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / bdag nyid kyis sems can thams cad dgrol bar bya'o/ /zhes sems can rnams la nges par gzhol pa dang /btang snyoms kyi ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par 'jug cing / sems can rnams kyi zag pa zad par bya ba la nges par gzhol bar byed pa ste/ de ni yibyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi 29—307

tshe / bsam gtan dang tshad med pa rnams kyi rnam pa dang / rtags dang /mtshan ma dag la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang yang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs par nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su mi bsngo ba de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nag nog med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe/ bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gis ma 'dres par gnas shing / nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'am/ sa gnyis po de dag tu 'dod par mi byed kyi/ de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bzod cing 'dod pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis mi dge ba'i chos spang ba dang / dge ba'i chos phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i phyir brtson pa mi gtong ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa rnams la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe/bsam gtan de dag dang / tshad med pa de dag dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la yang snyoms par 'jug ste/ bsam gtan dang /tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i dbang gis kyang mi skyel/ de dag gi ro myong 'obar yang mi byed cing / de dag gis kyang mi 'phrogs pa (bde ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa 29—308

rnams la spyod pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gi tshe rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dag gis bsam gtan dang / tshad med pa dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa de dag la snyoms par 'jug cing ldang bar yang byed la/de yang mi rtag pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i rnam pa dang / bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / zhi ba'i rnam pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dang /mtshan ma med pa'i rnam pa dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par so sor rtog kyang nyan thos kyi skyon med pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi skyon med par yang mi 'jug pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i 6)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis nang stong pa nyid shes pa gang yin pa dang / mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du shes pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang du chos thams cad la sems rnam par g.yeng ba med cing mnyam par bzhag par shes pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ni byang 29—309

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po la hu)yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni rtag ces bya bar ⑤shes pa mi 'jug /mi rtag ces bya ba dang / bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal ②zhes bya ba dang /bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar shes pa mi 'jug ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'das pa'i dus la shes pa mi 'jug /ma 'ongs pa'i dus la shes pa mi 'jug /da ltar byung ba'i dus la shes pa yang mi 'jug la/ de dus gsum po dag mi shes pa yang ma yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'dod pa'i khams su shes pa mi 'jug /gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs med 29—310

pa'i khams su shes pa mi 'jug la/ de 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams mi shes pa yang ma yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byarngo chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub ①sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams la shes pa mi 'jug /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams dang / zag pa dang bcas pa rnams dang /zag pa med pa rnams dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams la yang shes pa mi 'jug la/ de 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams mi shes pa yang ma yin/ zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams mi shes pa yang ma yin pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de'ang (gemi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa byams ma'i bu gang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ci tsam gyis na labyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya/ gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu (pe'adi la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang yang (gedag par gnas la/ de sbyin 29—311

pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang mi dmigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmigs/len pa po yang mi dmigs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas pa yang de bzhin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas la/ de ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang mi dmigs/ byang chub sems dpa' yang mi dmigs/ yid la byed pa yang mi dmigs te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems ma 'dres pas bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir nang stong pa nyid sgom ②ste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom shemo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems ma 'dres pa dag gis bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du sgom ④ste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 29—312

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems ma 'dres pa dag gis bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun sgom ①ste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems ma 'dres pa dag gis bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom (kyeste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems ma 'dres pa dag gis bsgom pa rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag sgom (kyeste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems can gyi khams dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni tha snyad ④tsam du zad par shes so/ /gzugs dmigs su med pa'i phyir/'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba de yang ming tsam du zad do/ /rnam par shes pa'i bar du dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /mig dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ mig ces bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /yid dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/yid ces bya ba'i bar de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /khams rnams dang skye mched 29—313

rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyang de bzhin no/ /nang stong pa nyid dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 3)dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ 'di lta ste/de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / ②chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /sangs rgyas dmigs su med pa'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub dang / sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do (0zhes bya bar shes te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing na gang la gang 'os pa'i mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsti stang du byed do/ /bla mar byed do/ /29—314

ri mor ①byed do/ /mchod pa 90byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las 'di lta ste/ theg pa chen po 'di nyid kyi chos nyan to/ /de theg pa chen po de la zhin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par byed/ sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed la/ de la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'du shes kyang mi 'byung /sems can gyi 'du shes kyang mi 'byung ngo / /de gnyis su med pa'i sa la gnas te / lus ci lta bus sems can rnams kyi don byed nus pa de lta bu'i lus bsams ①bzhin du yongs su 'dzin to/ /de ④rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par gyur gyi bar du nam yang theg pa de dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro//des rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bskor bar mi nus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshan ro/ /de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i ⑥klung gi bye ma snyed dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag kyang de'i bsngags pa rjod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam dzi)ga ge mo zhes bya ba zhig na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di zhes bya ba zhig theg pa chen po la zhin nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor to zhes snyan pa sgrogs shing dbyangs rjod pa namadzad do/ /de bzhin du 29—315

lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang ①/ shar lho dang /lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang (0gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang de'i bsngags pa rjod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams ga ge mo zhes bya ba zhig na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di zhes bya ba zhig rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te ③zhes snyan pa sgrogs shing dbyangs rjod pa mdzad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi le'u zhes bya ste bcu gsum pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po bcu pa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das go cha chen po bgos/ go cha chen po bgos zhes bgyi na/bcom ldan 'das ci tsam gyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos zhes bgyi ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po'i go cha bgos pa 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu 29—316

phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i go cha bgos/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i go cha bgos/ yang dag pa'i 3)spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /lam gyi go cha bgos/ nang stong pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi go cha bgos/ stobs kyi go cha bgos/ mi 'jigs pa'i go cha bgos/ so so yang dag par (gyirig pa'i go cha bgos/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi go cha bgos/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go cha bgos/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i go cha bgos nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang bas khyab par byed cing g.yo bar yang byed de/ sems can dmyal ba thams cad kyi gnas rnams su me rab tu zhi bar byas nas/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnams rab tu zhi bar byas te/ sems can de dag la sdug bsngal rnams zhi bar rig par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' de 'di skad ces de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod cing dbyangs sgrog go/ /de nas sems can dmyal ba pa de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas bde ba dang / yid bde ba thob ste/ bde ba dang / yid bde ba de nyid kyis ri ge sems can dmyal ba de dag nas byung nas/gang dang gang na ④sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs te mthong zhing mnyes par byar yod pa dang / lha dang mir skye bar 'gyur ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang der skye'o/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas sems can rnams byung nas/ gang dang gang na sangs rgyas 29—317

bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa de dang der skye'o/ /de bzhin du shar dang /lho dang / nub dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang /lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag snang bas khyab par byed cing / rnam pa drug tu g.yo bar yang byed de/ sems can dmyal ba thams cad kyi gnas rnams su me rab tu zhi bar byas nas/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal rnams rab tu zhi bar hu)byas te/ sems can de dag la sdug bsngal rnams zhi bar rig par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' de 'di skad cesal/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra rjod cing dbyangs sgrog go/ /de nas sems can dmyal ba pa de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi sgra de thos nas bde ba dang /yid bde ba thob ste(kye/ bde ba dang / yid bde ba de nyid kyis sems can dmyal ba de dag nas byung nas/ gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs te/ mthong zhing / bsnyen bkur byar yod pa dang /lha dang mir skye bar 'gyur ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang der skye'o/ /mir skyes nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la mnyes par byed do/ /de bzhin du dud 'gro'i skye gnas rnams dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams nas sems can de dag shi 'phos te/ gang dang gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dang der skye'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'ol/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan 29—318

gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi 0)mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du sems can dmyal ba dag dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten mngon par sprul la/ des mngon par sprul nas/ sems can de dag la sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang / dge 'dun gyi sgra bsgrags te / de nas sprul pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi sgra dang / chos kyi sgra dang /dge 'dun gyi sgra des sems can dmyal ba de dag dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas byung bar gyur na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems / sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang sems can dmyal ba rnams dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag nas phyung ba yod snyam 'am/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams su sems can rnams ngan 'gro gsum po dag las yongs su bgrol yang sems can 'ga' yang yongs su bkrol bar gyur pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o / /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la na gnas te/ go cha chen po bgos nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams be+e drur+ya'i ( rang bzhin du mngon par sprul te / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bai drur+ya'i burang bzhin 29—319

du mngon par sprul nas/ 'khor los sgyur ①ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul pa byed do/ /des 'khor los sgyur ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul nas/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas sbyin par byed do/ /de bzhin du btung ba dang /gos dang / bzhon pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / yo byad dang /gnas dang / mal cha dang / bgo ba dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang / rtsi sman dang / gser dang / dngul dang / nor bu dang / rin po che dang /byi zhuru dang / dung dang / man shel dang / mu tig dang / rgyan dag dang / yo byad gang yang rung ba dag sbyin par byed do/ /des zas 'dod pa rnams la zas sbyin ①zhing yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar dag byin nas sems can de dag la 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyi chos ston to/ /sems can de dag gis kyang chos bstan pa de thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang nam yang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro//rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi ④mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas byin zhing /mi'i yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar du byin na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems / sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can gang la yang ci yang byin pa yod snyam 'am/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de 29—320

bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'khor los sgyur ba'i bkod pa mngon par sprul te/ zas 'dod pa rnams la zas byin zhing / mi'i yo byad gang yang rung ba'i bar du byin yang / sems can gang la yang ci yang byin pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ bsams (3)bzhin du skye ba yongs su 'dzin cing 'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs su skye ste(kye/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang phyug de la gnas nas/ sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la 'god par byed/bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi la 'god par byed/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bar dag la 'god par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la 'god par byed cing / sems can de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang chos bstan pa de dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' 29—321

yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la bkod pa yod snyam 'am/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can grangs med tshad med zhi)pa dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la bkod kyang / sems can 'ga' yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pa'am/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung nas chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing 'god par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can rnams bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyor zhing 'god ce na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed phyin chad 'di ltar go cha chen po bgos te/ gal te sems can thams cad kyis bdag la dbyig 2pa dang / bong ba dang / khu tshur dang / lag cha dang / mtshon gyis 'debs 5she kyang de la bdag gis 'khrug pa'i sems 'ga' yang bskyed par mi bya'o snyam zhing / sems can thams cad kyang bzod pa de lta bu la 'god do/ /29—322

rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sbyar cing ①bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod snyam 'am/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can grangs med tshad med pa dag bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod kyang / sems can 'ga' yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' sbyon chen po sems can thams cad brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god ce na / rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i ②yid la bya ba dag gis sems can thams cad lus dang sems kyi 29—323

brtson 'grus yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi ①mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du/ skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas/ lus dang / sems kyi brtson 'grus yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang lus dang / sems kyi brtson 'grus yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod pa yod snyam 'am/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad lus dang / sems kyi brtson 'grus yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod kyang / sems can 'ga' yang lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 29—324

yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god ce na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la gnas shing / chos gang la yang rnam par g.yeng ba 'am/ rnam par g.yeng ba med par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ des de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /yang dag par 'dzin du bcug pa de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi ①mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam / sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod pa yod snyam 'am / rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod kyang / sems can 'ga' yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa 29—325

med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ①sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji (kyeltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug (khucing 'dzud de 'god ce na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ chos gang la yang skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'am/ rnam par byang ba'am/ tshu rol lam/ pha rol mi dmigs sol/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa yin te/ des de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi lamador skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud ⑤de bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa yod snyam 'am/29—326

rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ①la bkod kyang / sems can 'ga' yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o / /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ni shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can gang dag 'khod pa'i sems can dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed do/ /de bzhin du ji ltar bdag tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa bzhin du sems can de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar dag yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god par byed la/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa tshon)'di nyid kyi chos kyang ston to/ /sems can de dag kyang chos de thos nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du lho 29—327

dang / nub dang / byang dang / byang shar dang / shar lho dang / lho nub dang / nub byang dang / 'og dang / steng gi phyogs kyi phyogs re rer 6)yang 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag tu song zhing / de ji ltar bdag sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sems can gang dag 'khod pa'i sems can de dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la nayang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god do/ /de bzhin du ji ltar bdag tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa bzhin du sems can de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar dag yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de 'god rdo la 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa 'di nyid kyi chos kyang ston to/ /sems can de dag kyang chos de thos nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du nam yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi (4)mdor skye (ge)bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de 6bkod na/ rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma 7mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug yang dag par 'dzin du bcug cing btsud de bkod pa yod snyam 'am/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 29—328

ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shar phyogs dang /phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed po de dag gi sems can de dag thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod kyang sems can 'ga' yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor de 6)gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha chen po bgos pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas shing / sems bskyed pa gzhan gyi skabs mi 'byed de/ bdag gis sems can 'di snyed cig ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o//sems can 'di snyed cig ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dgod par bya'o / /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni lan cig 29—329

phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni rang byang chub la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o/ /sems can 'di snyed cig ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 0)la dgod par bya'o/ /'di snyed cig ni dgod par mi bya'o snyam du mi sems kyi gzhan du na de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dgod par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa na bdun la dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa (lderabargyad la dgod par bya'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par bya'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang /rang byang chub la dgod par bya'o/ /bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar dag la dgod par bya'o snyam du sems so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma mkhas pa zhig gis lam po che'i bzhi tsho )mdor skye bo phal po che'i mdun du skye bo'i tshogs chen po zhig mngon par sprul nas/ 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can tshad med grangs med pa 'di dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug la dgod par bya'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi la dgod par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 9bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag (6ril dgod par bya'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dgod par 29—330

bya'o / /dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub kyi bar la dgod par bya'o//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dgod par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed na/rab 'byor 'di ji snyam du sems/ sgyu ma mkhan nam/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi slob ma des sems can 'ga' yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bkod pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar la bkod pa yod snyam 'am/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal 1pa/ rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos tsho sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i bar dag 9kyel dgod par sems bskyed kyang sems can 'ga'i don gyi phyir yang sems bskyed pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal ba ltar na/ chos rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi slad du sgyu ma'i chos nyid nye bar bzung na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha 'tshal bar 4rig par bgyi ba lags pa snyam 5bgyid do/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong / mig ni mig gis stong / rna ba dang / sna dang /29—331

lce dang / lus dang / yid ni yid kyis stong / gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos ni chos kyis stong / mig gi rnam par shes pa 91 ni mig gi rnam par shes pas stong / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong 9ge/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa ni mig gi 'dus te reg pas stong / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor bas stong /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor bas stong / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar gyini shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bar gyis stong /nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyis stong / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar gyis stong la/ bcom ldan 'das byaja chub sems dpa' yang byang chub sems dpas tsho4stong / go cha chen po yang go cha chen pos stong pa'i slad du ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni go cha ma mchis pa'i go cha 'tshal bar rig par bgyi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang 29—332

ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor de de bzhin no//de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni ma byas/ ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang dag gi don du go cha chen po bgos pa'i sems can de dag kyang ma byas/ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pal/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma bgyis/ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma bgyis shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang dag gi don du go cha chen po 'tshal ba'i sems can de dag kyang ma bgyis/ ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma bgyis pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byed pa po mi dmigs pas/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma byas/ ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma byas shing 0)/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang dag gi don du go cha chen po bgos pa'i sems can de dag kyang ma byas/ ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma byas pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ltar gzugs ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni mi byed/mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ mig ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ gzugs ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /29—333

reg bya dang / chos rnams ni mi byed/ mi 51)'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/mig gi rnam par shes pa ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa nimi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni mi byed/mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed/ rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba ni mi byed/ mi 'jig/mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor bdag ni mi byed/ mi 'jig/mngon par 'du mi byed/ sems can dang / srog dang / shes pa po dang /mthong ba po'i bar ni mi 2byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor rmi lam ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /sgyu ma dang / brag ca dang / mig yor dang / gzugs brnyan dang / smig cargyu dang / sprul pa ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed dol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir rol/ /rab 'byor dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar ni mi byed/mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de 29—334

dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi bar dag ni mi byed mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin nyid ni mi byed / mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag stigatan med mon cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang /chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos gnas pa nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag nacigatan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub ni mi byed/ mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang /4 rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni mi byed/mi 'jig /mngon par 'du mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag gtan med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir te5/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/khyod kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang ma byas/ ma bshig /mngon par 'dus ma byas la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos gang dag gi don du go cha chen po 6)bgos pa'i sems can de dag kyang ma byas/ ma bshig/29—335

mngon par 'dus ma byas pa (1)yin par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po go cha ( chen po bgos pa zhes bya'o/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal ba ltar na/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs ni ma bcings nam grol ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings 0ma grol ba lags so/ /byams ma'i bu gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba zhes smra'am/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa 'a)ma bcings ma grol ba zhes smra'am/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po de de bzhin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de de bzhin te/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /gang pos smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gzugs ma bcings ma grol ba gang yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba gang yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po rmi lam lta bu'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o / /rmi lam lta bu'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rmi lam lta bu'i rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de ni ma bcings ma grol ba'ol/ /de bzhin du brag ca 6lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / mig yor lta bu dang / gzugs brnyan lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu'i 29—336

gzugs gang yin pa de ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /sprul pa lta bu'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po 'das pa'i gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po 'das pa'i tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ma 'ongs pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po da ltar byung ba'i gzugs ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po da ltar byung ba'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / da ltar byung ba'i rnam par shes pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po gzugs nyid med pa'i phyir/ gzugs de ma bcings ma grol ba'o//tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams med pa (1dang / rnam par shes pa nyid med pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa de ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de bzhin du gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa dben pa dang / zhi ba dang / stong pa dang /mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa dang / skye ba med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po gzugs dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa dang /nyon mongs pa med pa dang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang / kha na ma tho 29—337

ba med pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gzugs nyid med pa'i phyir gzugs de ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa dge ba'am mi dge ba nas rnam par byang ba'i bar yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rnam par shes pa nyid med pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa de ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po chos thams cad kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de bzhin du dben pa la sogs pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 1dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang ma bcings ma grol ba ste/ med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o//dben pa la sogs 2pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po nang stong pa nyid kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i bar dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 29—338

bcwa brgyad kyi bar du yang ma bcings ma grol ba ste/ med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /dben pa la sogs pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po byang chub kyang ma bcings ma grol ba 6)rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang ma bcings (gem grol ba/ byang chub sems dpa' yang ma bcings ma grol ba ste/ med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /dben pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /skye ba med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de bzhin nyid kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos gnas pa nyid dang /chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' yang ma bcings ma grol ba ste/med pa dang / dben pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /skye ba med pa'i phyir ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /de ltar na pha rol tu phyin pa drug po dag kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar dag kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /sems can gang dag yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar 'gyur ba de dag kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dag dag par bya bar 'gyur ba de dag kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /bsnyen tsho ribakur bya bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /thos par 'gyur ba'i chos kyang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang nam yang bral bar mi 'gyur ba'ang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams dang 29—339

bral bar mi 'gyur ba dang / mig lnga dang bral bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang bral bar mi 'gyur ba yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bskyed par 'gyur ba yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur ba yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /theg pa gsum po dag gis sems can rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar 'gyur ba yang ma bcings ma grol ba'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa gang po med pa dang / dben pa dang / skye ba med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar ma bcings ma grol ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug po dag gis chos thams cad mngon par rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las ma bcings ma grol ba'i le'u zhes bya ste/ bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs par rig par bgyi/ theg pa de ni gang la yang dag par zhugs pa lags/ theg pa de ni gang du gnas par 'gyur ba lags/ theg pa des ni su zhig nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor khyod gang 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems 29—340

dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni gang lags zhes zer ba ni/ rab 'byor pha rol tu phyin pa drug ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin te/ drug gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis 'di lta ste / phyi dang nang gi dngos po rnams sbyin pa sbyin par byed cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bla na ①med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo 9gyibar byed pa ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bdag kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs shing gnas la sems can gzhan dag kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing 'dzud de rab tu 'god par byed pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nag nog med pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis 29—341

gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis/ bdag kyang bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan la/ gzhan dag kyang bzod pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug cing / de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byed pa de ni rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis bdag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa lnga la brtson pa mi 'dor 1)zhing / gzhan dag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug ste/de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byed pa de ni rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi (2༄pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor ri'adi la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ④rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis thabs la mkhas pas bdag 5)kyang bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug cing / de dag gi dbang gis kyang mi skye la/ gzhan dag kyang bsam gtan rnams yang dag par 29—342

'dzin du 'jug ste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byed pa de ni rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pa dag gis mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la so sor rtog par byed cing / gzhan dag kyang chos thams cad la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la so sor rtog pa yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa de ni rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po bcu gcig pa/rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po ni 'di lta ste/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa 3)nyid dang / rang bzhin (lde)stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang /rige rang gi 29—343

mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / 1mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin no/ /de la nang stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ nang gi chos rnams te/ mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid de(5ci/ de la ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/mig ni mig gis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/rna ba ni na rna bas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa cadang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/sna ni snas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de 5yin pa'i phyir ro//ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ lce ni lces stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ lus ni lus kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ yid ni yid kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/de ni nang stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la phyi stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ phyi rol gyi chos rnams te/ 'di lta ste/ gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya 6dang / chos rnams so/ / de la 7༄ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du ther 29wa 344

zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos ni chos kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni phyi stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la phyi nang stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ nang gi skye mched drug dang / phyi'i skye mched drug po de dag ni phyi dang nang gi chos rnams zhes bya'o/ /de la nang gi chos rnams phyi'i chos rnams kyis stong pa gang zhe na/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ nang gi mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid rnams ni phyi'i gzugs dang / sgra dang /dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ phyi rol gyi chos gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams ni nang gi chos mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid rnams kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/de ni phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa'i stong pa nyid des 1stong pa nyid stong pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la chen po stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ shar phyogs ni/ shar phyogs kyis stong ngo 2/ /lho phyogs ni lho phyogs kyis stong ngo nano/ /nub phyogs 29—345

ni nub phyogs kyis stong ngo 1)/ /byang phyogs ni byang phyogs kyis stong ngo rdzunan/ /'og gi phyogs ni 'og gi phyogs kyis stong ngo tsho —/ /steng gi phyogs ni steng gi phyogs kyis stong ngo ( ri/ /de bzhin du phyogs mtshams rnams 5ni phyogs mtshams rnams kyis stong ngo (6/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te / de ni chen po stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la don dam pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ don dam pa zhes bya ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ mya ngan las 'das pa de yang mya ngan las 'das pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni don dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la 'dus byas stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'dus byas zhes bya ba ni 'dod pa'i khams dang /gzugs kyi khams dang / gzugs med pa'i khams te/ de la ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i khams ni 'dod pa'i khams kyis stong / /gzugs kyi khams ni gzugs kyi khams kyis stong / gzugs med pa'i khams ni gzugs med pa'i khams kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ de la 'dus ma byas zhes bya ba ni gang la skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang /'jig pa med pa dang / gnas pa med pa dang / gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa de ni 'dus ma byas pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas de yang 'dus ma byas kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni 'dus ma byas stong 29—346

pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la mtha' mi dmigs pa de ni mtha' las 'das pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ mtha' ni mthas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la thog ma dang tha ma mi dmigs pa de la dbus med cing /gang la thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus med pa de la 'ong ba dang 'gro ba med pa ste/ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang dbus dang tha ma rnams ni/ thog ma dang dbus dang tha ma rnams kyis stong stespyi/de ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la dor ba med pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ chos gang la yang (midor du med pa ste/ ther zug gtu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ dor ba med pa ni dor ba med ④pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/de ni dor ba med pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni nyan thos rnams dzo kyis ma byas/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma byas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ma byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma mdzad pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/rang bzhin ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /29—347

de la chos thams cad stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ chos thams cad ces bya ba ni gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid dang gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang /reg bya dang / chos rnams dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang /mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba dang / gzugs can gyi chos rnams dang / gzugs med pa'i chos rnams dang / 'dus byas kyi chos rnams dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos de dag ni chos thams cad ces bya ste/ de la ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad ni chos thams cad kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ni gzugs su rung ba/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid ni myong ba/ 'du shes kyi mtshan nyid ni 'dzin par byed pa/'du byed rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni mngon par 'du byed pa/ rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni rnam par shes par byed pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang /'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa 29—348

dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad ni rang rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o / /de la mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos gang yin pa de dag ni dmigs su med pa ste/ 'das pa rnams ni ma 'ongs pa la mi dmigs/ ma 'ongs pa rnams kyang 'das pa la mi dmigs/ da ltar byung ba rnams kyang 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa la mi dmigs so/ /ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ mi dmigs pa ni mi dmigs pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na / de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la dngos po med pa stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la dngos po 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni dngos po med pa stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang la ngo bo nyid 'ga' yang mi dmigs pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang /'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ chos rnams rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir 'dus pa las byung ba'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid med pa ste/ ther zug tu gnas pa med pa dang / 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/29—349

'dus pa ni 'dus pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ de ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba ni/dngos po ni dngos pos stong / dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pas stong /ngo bo nyid ni ngo bo nyid kyis stong / gzhan gyi dngos po ni gzhan gyi dngos pos stong pa ste/ de la dngos po gang zhe na/ dngos po zhes bya ba ni phung po lnga ste/de la phung po lnga po dag ni ma skyes pa'i phyir dmigs su med pas/ de ltar na ①dngos po ni dngos pos stong ngo / /dngos po med pa yang dngos po med pas ji ltar stong zhe na/ dngos po med pa zhes bya ba ni 'dus ma byas pa ste/ de la 'dus ma byas pa yang 'dus ma byas pas stong bas/ de ltar na dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pas stong ngo / /ji ltar na ngo bo nyid ngo bo nyid kyis stong zhe na/ngo bo nyid ces bya ba ni phyin ci ma log pa'i rang bzhin te/ de la stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni shes pas ma byas mthong bas ma byas pas na ②de ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de la gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung ste/ chos gnas pa nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' de ni gnas pa nyid de/de ltar gzhan gyi (snye stong pa gang yin pa de ni gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid ces bya'o / /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i theg pa chen po yin no/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 29—350

chen po'i theg pa chen po ni mi 'di lta ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin chen phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / seng ge rnam par rtse ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / zla ba'i rgyal mtshan tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad las shin tu 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / spyi gtsug rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings su nges pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nges pa'i rgyal 2mtshan tog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje rin po che tsho zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 4'dzin dang / ting nge 'dzin la rgyal po ltar rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / 'od zer (snyerab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dpung bkod pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nges pa'i tshig bstan pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /tshig bla dgas la yang dag par 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /phyogs la rnam par lta du'achib zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / brjed 97)pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad yang dag par 'du ba rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' khyab par byed pa 8)zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rin po che spong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / tshol (kheb med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gnas la 29—351
