gzugs mu 1ma mchis pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' mu ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa mu ma mchis pa'i slad du/ byang chub sems dpa' mu ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis shing 2mi dmigs lags so/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de lta bu yang ma mchis shing mi dmigs lags (na so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis thams cad kyi thams cad rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ma cadamigs lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang la gdams shing rjes su bstan par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de ni ming tsam du bas 5lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper bgyi na/ bdag bdag ces bgyi ba yang bdag mngon par grub pa ni gtan ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi yang / byang chub sems dpa' mngon par grub pa ni gtan ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos rnams rang bzhin ma mchis pa lags na/ gang mngon par grub pa'i gzugs de gang lags/gang mngon par grub pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / gang mngon par grub pa'i rnam par shes pa de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das gang mngon par ma 'grub pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /gang 29wa 502

mngon par ma grub pa 17de ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par ma grub pa las gud na gang byang chub kyi slad du spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dmigs su ma mchis na/ ci mngon par ma grub pa de mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams par bgyi zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi lags sam/bcom ldan 'das de ltar bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi zhum mi 'gong zhing / yid 'gyod par mi 'gyur la mi skrag 2mi dngang zhing dngang bar mi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags par rig par bgyi'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' phyi ma'i mthar khas mi len pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' dbus su khas mi len pa yin/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir/ gzugs mu med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis thams 29—503

cad kyi thams cad rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag par rjes su ma mthong / ma 4)dmigs lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang la gdams par bgyi zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi zhes smra/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de ni ming tsam du bas lags so zhes bya ba'i bar du smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na/ bdag bdag ces bgyi yang bdag mngon par grub pa ni gtan ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub (na)sems dpa' zhes bgyi yang byang chub sems dpa' mngon par grub pa ni gtan ma mchis lags so zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos rnams dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid lags na/gang mngon par ma grub pa'i gzugs de gang lags/ gang mngon par ma rmegrub pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / gang mngon par ma 5grub pa'i rnam par shes pa de gang lags/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ma lags so zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ ci nesamangon par ma grub pa de mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams par bgyi zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi lags sam zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par ma 29wa 504

grub pa las gud ①na yang gang byang chub kyi slad du spyod (gepa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs su ma mchis pa lags so zhes smra/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi zhum/mi 'gong zhing yid 'gyod ②par mi 'gyur la/ mi skrag mi dngang zhing /dngang bar mi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags par rig par bgyi'o zhes smra/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sems can med ( pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sems can stong pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sems can dben pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sems can dngos po med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /gzugs stong pa dang / gzugs dben pa dang / gzugs ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /rnam par shes pa stong pa dang / rnam par shes pa dben pa dang / rnam par shes pa ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med pa'i phyir/29—505

byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dben pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' 1sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar stong pa nyid la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams kyang mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan zhing / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams kyang gzhan ma yin pas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni gnyis su med cing riganyis su dbyer med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu/med pa yang gzhan/ stong pa nyid kyang gzhan/ dben pa yang gzhan/ ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan/ sbyin pa'i 29—506

pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan/bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan zhing / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /dbus rnams kyang gzhan pa ma yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na med pa gang yin pa dang / stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang / dben pa gang yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam (1 grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' dang /dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nang stong pa nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mthar khas mi len to/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du med pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nang stong pa nyid med pa dang / nang stong pa nyid stong pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dben pa dang / nang stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' dang /phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du med pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshon/dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa 29—507

nyid dben pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /nang stong pa nyid med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan la/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang /① ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan zhing byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan la/ sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams kyang gzhan pa ma yin te/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na nang stong pa nyid med pa dang / stong pa dang /dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang /ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang yin pa dang /sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams stong pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dben pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de bzhin du yang dag par laspong ba rnams 29—508

med pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams stong pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dben pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar med pa dang / stong pa dang /dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams mi ①dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /med pa yang gzhan ma yin/stong pa yang gzhan ma yin/ dben pa yang gzhan ma yin/ ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan ma yin zhing / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang gzhan ma yin la/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du yang gzhan ma yin zhing / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams 2kyang gzhan ( ma yin pa'i phyir te/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa gang yin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi bar dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang /phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus 29—509

rnams su khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin thams cad med pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad med pa dang / chos kyi dbyings med pa dang / de bzhin nyid med pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' med pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' stong pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dben pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ting nge 'dzin med pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar du med pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar du ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu med pa yang gzhan/ stong pa yang gzhan/dben pa yang gzhan/ ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar du yang gzhan zhing / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams kyang gzhan pa ma yin te/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na med pa gang yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa'i bar gang yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gang yin pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha'i bar dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang /phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams gang yin pa de dag ni thams cad kyi thams cad rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang nyan thos med pa'i phyir byang chub sems 29—510

dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /nyan thos stong pa dang / nyan thos dben pa dang / nyan thos ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /rang sangs rgyas med pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' med pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid med pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid stong pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dben pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro//med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa yang gzhan zhing byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyang gzhan la sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams kyang gzhan ma yin te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na med pa dang / stong pa dang / dben pa dang / ngo bo nyid med pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas de dag ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na byang chub sems ①dpa' sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / dbus rnams su khas mi len to/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu khyod gang 'di skad du/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir/ gzugs mu med pa'i 29—511

phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' la ni mtha' dang / dbus dang mtha' mi dmigs kyang /nam mkha' zhes tha snyad 'dogs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du gzugs stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir gzugs kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid la ni mtha' 'am/dbus dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir tshor ba 1dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs / dbus mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid la ni mtha' 'am/ dbus dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/gzugs mu med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du khams dang / skye mched rnams dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par naspong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 29—512

dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres 3)pa rnams ni nam mkha' dang mnyam pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri ri'i bu 'di lta ste dper na/mtha' yas mu med pa'i phyir nam mkha' la mtha' 'am/ dbus mi dmigs kyang nam mkha' zhes tha snyad 'dogs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi bar du stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la mtha' 'am/ dbus mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid la mtha' 'am/dbus dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na / sangs rgyas kyi ༅chos rnams mu med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mu med par rig par bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi ④dmigs pa yin/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin nam 5)zhes zer ba ni tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid la ni gzugs med cing mi dmigs so(7/ /stong pa nyid la ni byang chub sems dpa' med cing mi dmigs la/ de bzhin du stong pa nyid la ni tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa med cing mi 29—513

dmigs / stong pa nyid la ni 3)byang chub sems dpa' med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin no/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid la ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med cing / stong pa nyid la ni byang chub sems dpa' med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /yang dag par risaspong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / lam rnams dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /chos kyi dbyings ni chos kyi dbyings kyis stong ngo / /de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin 29—514

nyid kyis stong ngo / /yang dag pa'i mtha' ni yang dag pa'i mthas 0)stong ngo / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings kyis stong ngo //ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin gyis stong ngo / /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ngo / /thams cad shes pa nyid ni thams cad shes pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa ②nyid kyis stong ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /nyan thos kyi ②theg pa ni nyan thos kyi theg pas stong ngo / /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas stong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni sangs rgyas kyi theg pas stong ngo / /nyan thos ni nyan thos kyis stong ngo / /rang sangs rgyas ni rang sangs rgyas kyis stong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' ni byang chub sems dpas stong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pas stong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin gshegs pa stong pa nyid la ni gzugs med cing mi ④dmigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stong pa nyid la ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gzugs byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin no/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 95)de lta bu yang med cing mi dmigs pa yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar bdag gis thams cad kyi ⑥thams cad rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du/29—515

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang dag par rjes su ma mthong /ma tsho1dmigs lags na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang la gdams par bgyi zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni gzugs la dmigs su med do(kye/ /gzugs ni tshor ba la dmigs su med do/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba la dmigs su med do/ /tshor ba ni gzugs la dmigs su med do/ /gzugs dang / tshor ba dag ni 'du shes la dmigs su med do/ /'du shes ni 'du shes la dmigs su med do/ /'du shes ni gzugs dang / tshor ba dag la dmigs su med do/ /'du byed rnams ni 'du shes la med cing mi dmigs so/ /'du byed rnams ni 'du byed rnams dal med cing mi dmigs so/ /'du shes ni 'du byed rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni 'du byed rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /'du byed rnams ni rnam par shes pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes ni 'du byed rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams ni rnam par shes pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rnam par shes pa ni gzugs dang /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig ni mig la med cing mi dmigs so/ /mig ni rna ba la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba ni mig la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba ni rna ba la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba ni sna la med cing mi dmigs so/ /sna ni sna la med cing mi dmigs so/ /sna ni mig dang rtsirna ba la med cing mi 29—516

dmigs so/ /sna ni lce la med cing mi dmigs so/ /lce ni lce la med cing mi dmigs so/ /lce ni mig dang rna ba dang / sna dag la med cing mi dmigs so//lce ni lus la med cing mi dmigs so/ /lus ni lus la med cing mi dmigs so//lus ni mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /lus ni yid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /yid ni yid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /yid ni mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzugs ni gzugs la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzugs ni sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang /chos rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /sgra ni sgra la med cing mi dmigs so/ /sgra ni gzhan dag la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du dri ni dri dang /gzhan dag la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /ro ni ro dang gzhan dag la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /reg bya ni reg bya dang gzhan dag la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /chos ni chos rnams dang gzhan dag la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa ni mig gi rnam par shes pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzhan dag kyang de la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de dag la yang de med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni de bzhin te/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang yid kyi rnam par shes pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzhan dag kyang de la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de yang gzhan dag la med cing mi dmigs so/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa ni mig gi 'dus te reg pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /29—517

de ni gzhan dag 6)la yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /de la gzhan dag kyang med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang de bzhin te/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa la yang reg pa gzhan dag med cing mi dmigs so/ /mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba ni/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de la yang gzhan dag dang gzhan dag la yang gzhan dag med cing mi dmigs so/ /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yang yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de la yang gzhan dag dang /gzhan dag la yang gzhan dag med cing mi dmigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du yang dag par rinaspong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang /dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad po dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa (gernams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ni/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /so so yang dag par 29—518

rig pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad ni chos thams cad la med cing mi dmigs so/ /chos thams cad ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar la med cing mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyi bar la med cing mi dmigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin la med cing mi dmigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin ni gzungs rnams la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzungs ni gzungs la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gzungs ni ting nge 'dzin la med cing mi dmigs so/ /so so'i skye bo'i sa ni so so'i ②skye bo'i sa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang /bslabs pa'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs ②pa can gyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du rgyun du zhugs pa ni rgyun du zhugs pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas ni rang sangs rgyas nyid la med cing mi dmigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la med cing mi dmigs so//29—519

byang chub sems dpa' ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 15)med cing mi dmigs so / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa ni/ gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa la med cing mi dmigs so//byang chub sems dpa' ni gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa la med cing mi dmigs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de ltar na chos thams cad med cing mi dmigs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' yang med cing mi dmigs te bstan du med do / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bgyi ba de ni ming tsam du bas lags so zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de tshon ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi ming de ni phyogs bcu gang nas kyang mi 'ong gang du yang mi 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang gang nas kyang mi 'ong / gang du yang mi 'gro'o/ /'di ltar 'di lta ste/ gzugs zhes bya ba dang / tshor ba zhes bya ba dang /'du shes zhes bya ba dang / 'du byed rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de dag ni glo bur du ming du btags pa yin no/ /ming gang yin pa de yang gzugs ma yin/ tshor ba ma yin/ 'du shes ma yin/ 'du byed rnams ma yin/ rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/29—520

'di ltar ming ni ming gi ngo bo nyid kyis stong la/ stong pa gang yin pa de ni ming ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ①ni ming tsam ste/ ming la yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa med la/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang ming med do//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang /risasbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyi ga yang med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/② byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /de bzhin du 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ④ni ming tsam ste/ ming la yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang ming med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de gnyi ga yang pa med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir te/ de'i phyir 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni glo bur du ming du btags pa yin pas/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste/nang stong pa nyid ces bya ba dang / dngos po 6med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i bar de ni ming tsam ste/ nang stong pa nyid las gud na yang ming med la/ ming la yang nang stong pa nyid med do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo 29wa 521

nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar las gud na yang ming med la/ ming la yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar dag med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid gang yin pa dang /0) dngos po med pa'i rdzu ningo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gang yin pa de gnyi ga yang med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam (bgrangs des na 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni ming tsam du zad do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams zhes bya ba de ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhas pa rnams las gud na yang ming med la/ ming la yang dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / dran pa nye bar ④gzhag pa rnams gang yin pa ⑤de gnyi ga yang med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du yang dag par ⑥spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang /stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad ces bya ba de dag ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams las gud na yang ming med la/ ming la yang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams gang yin pa de gnyi ga yang med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du 'di lta ste/29—522

ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams zhes bya ba dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba'i bar dag ni glo bur du ming du btags pa ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las gud na yang ming med la/ ming la yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar ming gang yin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar gang yin pa de gnyi ga yang med cing mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir 'di skad du/ 'di lta ste/ dper bgyi na/ bdag bdag ces bgyi ba yang bdag mngon par grub pa ni gtan ma mchis lags so zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu bdag gtan med cing mi dmigs na/de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sems can dang / srog dang / skye ba po dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang / byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang / shes pa po dang / mthong ba po gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid gtan 29—523

med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin du sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yodagyo)/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig gi rnam par shes pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la 2yod/ rna ba )dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig gi 'dus te reg pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ④rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor (seb gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la (6yod / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /29—524

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nang stong pa nyid gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gtan med cing mi dmigs na / de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yang dag par ri1spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang /stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ting nge 'dzin rnams dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de dag mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nyan thos gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang sangs rgyas gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byang chub sems dpa' gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 2yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtan med cing mi dmigs na/ de mngon par 'grub par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod de —/ tshe dang ldan pa ngashā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/29—525

bdag bdag ces bya ba yang bdag mngon par grub ①pa ni gtan med pa yin no//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang khyod 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir 'di ltar chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid lags ②na zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de de bzhin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir ro/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gang gi 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med/ rab 'byor gyis 2)smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs kyi 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig gi 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid kyi 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang /chos rnams dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba dang /rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin 29—526

pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'dus pa las byung ba'i ngo bo nyid med de/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang chos thams cad ni mi rtag pa ste/ gang dang zhi)yang bral bas ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor chos thams cad ni mi rtag pa ste/gang dang yang bral bas ma yin pa de gang yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu ②gzugs ni mi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni mi rtag pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar mi rtag pa gang yin pa de ni zad pa'i dngos po med pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba dang /stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa ste kyi/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar smon pa med pa gang yin pa de ni zad pa'i dngos po med pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du chos thams cad ni dge ba dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / 'dus ma byas pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar 'dus ma byas pa gang yin pa de ni zad pa'i dngos po med pa'i phyir te /29—527

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ chos thams cad ni ngo bo nyid med pa ste/ gang dang yang bral bas ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang chos thams cad ni ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin/ 'jig 1)pa ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir chos thams cad ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin/ 'jig pa ma yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin/'jig pa ma yin no / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir rol/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin/ 'jig pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa dang /kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / zag pa dang bcas pa dang / zag pa med pa dang / nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'dus byas dang /'dus ma byas dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba'i chos rnams dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa yang ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin / 'jig pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i rang bzhin de yin pa'i phyir te/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir gang mngon par grub pa'i gzugs de gang lags/gang mngon par grub pa'i tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams 29wa 528

dang / gang mngon par grub pa'i rnam par shes pa de gang lags zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /tshor ba dang 'du shes dang / 'du byed 1rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar mngon par 'du byed pa po med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu mig ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / 'di ltar mngon par 'du byed pa po med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mngon par 'du byed pa po med pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzhan yang gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya dang / chos rnams ni mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mngon par 'du byed pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /chos thams cad kyi bar du yang mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar mngon par 'du byed pa po mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam rigrangs des na/ gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa rnams ni mngon par ma grub pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/ ci'i phyir gang mngon par ma grub kyipa de/ gzugs ma lags/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ma lags zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de de bzhin te/ de 29—529

de bzhin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar gzugs ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa gang yin pa de la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med do/ /gang la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med pa gang yin pa de la gzhan du 'gyur ba med do/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa gang yin pa de la skye ba med cing / 'jig pa med do/ /gang la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med pa de la gzhan du 'gyur ba med do/ /chos thams cad kyi bar du rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ gang dag rang bzhin gyis stong pa de dag la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med do/ /gang dag la skye ba med cing 'jig pa med pa de dag la gzhan du 'gyur ba med de/ rnam grangs des na/ gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni gzugs ma yin no/ /gang mngon par ma grub pa de ni tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du ci'i phyir ci mngon par ma grub pa de mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams par bgyi zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi lags sam zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar mngon par ma grub pa gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang yin pa de ni mngon par ma grub pa ste/ de ltar na mngon par ma grub pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med de/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ kho bos 'di skad du/ ci mngon par ma grub pa de mngon par ma grub pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gdams par bgyi 29—530

zhing rjes su bstan par bgyi lags sam zhes smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du ci'i phyir mngon par ma grub pa las gud na yang gang byang chub kyi slad du spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dmigs su ma mchis lags so zhes smra ①zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pas/ mngon par ma grub pa yang gzhan la/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ de ltar na mngon par ma grub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /mngon par ma grub pa las gud na gzugs yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / mngon par ma grub pa las gud na tshor ba ②dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ de ltar na mngon par ma dugrub pa dang / gzugs de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /de ltar na mngon par ma grub pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /de bzhin du mngon par ma grub pa las gud na chos thams cad kyi bar du yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ de ltar na mngon par ma grub pa dang / chos thams cad kyi bar de ni gnyis su med cing gnyis su dbyer med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ mngon par ma grub pa las gud na gang byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dmigs su med pa yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa/ bam po bcu ④bdun pa/29—531

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du ci'i phyir gal te de ltar bstan 17pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems mi zhum mi 'gong zhing / yid 'gyod par mi 'gyur la/ mi skrag ②mi dngang zhing /dngang bar mi 'gyur na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa lags par rig par bgyi'o zhes smra zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ni chos thams cad g.yo ba med par yang dag par rjes su mthong zhing chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / brag ca nalta bu dang / mig yor lta bu dang / gzugs brnyan lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bur yang dag par rjes su mthong ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ bstan pa 'di thos na ④mi skrag mi dngang zhing dngang bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing chos de dag la de ltar nye bar rtog pa de'i tshe gzugs khas mi len cing mi 'dzin la/ gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing /'di ni gzugs so zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de'i tshe tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa khas mi len cing /mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing /'di ni rnam par shes pa'o zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de bzhin du 29—532

de'i tshe/ mig ①khas mi len cing / mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing / 'di ni mig go zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de bzhin du de'i tshe rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang /lus dang / /yid khas mi len cing mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing 'di ni yid do zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de'i tshe sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa khas mi len cing mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing / 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de bzhin du de'i tshe tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu ( phyin pa khas mi len cing (8dmi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing / 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de'i tshe nang stong pa nyid khas mi len cing mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing 'di ni nang stong pa nyid do zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de bzhin du de'i tshe dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du khas mi len cing / mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ /mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing / 'di ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams khas mi len cing / mi 'dzin la 29—533

gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing 'di ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de'i tshe/ yang dag par 0)spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad khas mi len cing /mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de/ mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing /'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad dang /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad khas mi len cing / mi 'dzin la gnas par mi bgyid de / mngon par zhen par mi bgyid cing / 'di dag ni ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams so zhes 'dogs par mi bgyid lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni gzugs yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / de bzhin du phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ba'i slad du'o/ /29—534

de ci'i slad du zhe ①na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gzugs ni ma skyes pa ste/gzugs kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de gzugs ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /de ltar na gzugs dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar skye ba ma mchis pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma lags so/ /mig gi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni mig ma lags so/ /rna ba dang / sna dang /lce dang / lus dang / yid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni yid ma lags so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma lags so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma lags pa'i slad du'o / /de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni nang stong pa nyid ma lags so/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma lags te②/ de ltar na dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye 29—535

bar gzhag pa rnams kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma lags te/ de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de bzhin du yang dag par nya spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / stobs bcu dang /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi na skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma lags te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas /dkyi chos rnams dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du (rme zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar de bzhin nyid ni ma skyes pa ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni de bzhin nyid ma lags te/ de ltar na de bzhin nyid dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar skye ba ma mchis pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du de bzhin nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni de bzhin nyid ma lags sol/ /ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang /chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos gnas pa nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 29—536

dbyings kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma lags te①/ de ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar skye ba ma mchis pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / skye ba ma mchis pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gzugs ni mi rtag pa ste/ gzugs kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma lags te/ de ltar na phung po rnams dang / 'grib pa ②de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du'o/ /khams dang / skye mched rnams kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de dag ni khams dang / skye mched rnams ma lags te/ de ltar na khams dang /skye mched rnams dang / 'grib pa de ni chaganyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 29—537

'grib pa gang lags pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma lags te/ de ltar na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma lags te / de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu tshoraphyin pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das nang stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni nang stong pa nyid ma lags te/de ltar na nang stong pa nyid dang 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags ((so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du nang stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni nang stong pa nyid ma lags so/ /de bzhin du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma lags te / de ltar na dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po 29—538

ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma lags te/ de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lagasal/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste / de'i slad du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma lags so/ /yang dag par aspong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni lam ma lags te/ de ltar na lam dang / 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags sol/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i zhuslad du lam gyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni lam ma lags so/ /de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang /stobs bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de dag ni busangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ⑤rnams ma lags te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang 'grib pa de ni gnyis su ma mchis shing gnyis su dbyer ma mchis lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/29—539

bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar 'grib pa ni gcig ma lags/ mang po ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ de'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang yang gzugs zhes bgyi ba de ni gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa zhi)lags so/ /de bzhin du gang yang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bgyi ba de ni gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa pyosalags so/ /gang yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bgyi ba'i bar de yang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa ③lags so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khri brgyad stong pa las/ gnyis su med pa'i le'u zhes bya ④ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas tshe ribadang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la ⑥'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa chos 'di dag la ni ji ltar nye bar rtog /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' ni gang yin/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gang yin/ nye bar rtog pa ni gang yin/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang khyod 'di skad du byang chub sems dpa' ni gang yin zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub gang yin pa nyid sems dpa' yin pas/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /byang chub des kyang chos thams cad kyi rnam pa shes te/ chos de dag la mngon par zhen pa yang med do/ /chos gang dag gi rnam pa shes she na/29—540

gzugs kyi rnam pa shes te/ de la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i rnam pa shes te/ de la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /de bzhin du khams rnams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rnam pa shes te/ de la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad kyi rnam pa shes te/ de la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor chos thams cad kyi rnam pa gang yin/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam pa gang dag dang /rtags gang dag dang / mtshan ma gang dag gis chos rnams 'dzin pa ste/'di lta ste rnam pa gang dag dang / rtags gang dag dang / mtshan ma gang dag gis 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos rnams dang / gzugs rnams sam/ sgra rnams sam/ dri rnams sam/ ro rnams sam/ reg bya rnams sam/ chos rnams sam/ nang dang phyi'i chos rnams su 'dzin pa ste/de ni chos thams cad kyi rnam pa zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 7gang yin zhes zer ba ni/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba de ni ring du song ba ste/ de'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o/ /gang las ring du song zhe na/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang / —8 mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba las 29—541

ring du song / nyon mongs pa thams cad dang / lta bar gyur pa thams cad las ring du song / 'gro ba drug las ring du song ba ①ste/ de'i phyir ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ring du song ba ②ste / de'i phyir ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /nang stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar las ring du song ba ①ste/ de'i phyir ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par (0spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa las ring du song ba 5nyeste/ de'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /stobs rnams dang /mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad (6dpo dag las ring du long ba ⑦sto/ de'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar las ring du song ba (nyeste/ de'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs ⑨des na 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni ring du song ba zhes bya'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gang yang khyod 'di skad du nye bar rtog 3 )pa ni gang yin zhes zer ba ni/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/29—542

gzugs rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /gzugs smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go / /gzugs dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go / /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go / /rnam par shes pa bdag ①ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam ②par shes pa zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi ①zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang /mtshan ④ma med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /rnam par shes pa dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi ⑤pa rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu 29—543

phyin pa rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang / bdag ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang /zhi zhes bya ba dang / ma zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya ba dang / mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar du rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya ba'i bar du nye bar mi rtog go/ /dben zhes bya ba dang / mi dben zhes bya ba'i bar du nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams rtag ces bya ba dang /mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ yang dag par 0)spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang /stobs rnams nanodang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtag ces bya ba dang / mi rtag ces bya bar nye bar mi rtog go/ /bde zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal zhes bya ba dang /29—544

bdag ①ces bya ba dang / bdag med ces bya ba dang / zhi zhes bya ba dang /ma zhi zhes bya ba dang / stong zhes bya ba dang / mi stong zhes bya ba dang /mtshan ma yod ces bya ba dang / mtshan ma med ces bya ba dang / smon pa yod ces bya ba dang / smon pa med ces bya ba dang / dben zhes bya ba dang (5na/ mi dben zhes bya bar nye bar mi rtog ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ni/chos de dag la de ltar nye bar rtog par byed do/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir khyod 'di skad du/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar gzugs kyi ma skyes pa gang lags pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i ma skyes pa gang lags pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma lags so/ /de bzhin du khams dang /skye mched dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa gang lags pa de/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma lags so zhes smra/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu gzugs kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin te/ skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gzugs kyi skye ba med pa gang 29—545

yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam par shes pa'i stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin te/ skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rnam par shes pa'i skye ba med pa gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te/ skye ba med do / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu ①phyin pa'i stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te/skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i skye ba med pa gang yin pa de ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu nang stong pa nyid ni nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /nang stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni nang stong pa nyid ma yin te/ skye ba med do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ②kyi bar ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin te/ skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā 29—546

ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi skye ba med pa gang yin pa de ni/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ngo / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ma yin te/ skye ba med do/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu de bzhin du yang dag par nyaspong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /lam dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis stong ngo / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin te/ skye ba med do / /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi skye ba med pa gang yin pa de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir khyod 'di skad du/ 'di ltar gzugs kyi 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni gzugs ma lags so/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'grib pa gang lags pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma lags so/ /de bzhin du khams dang / skye mched dang / rten cing (snye 'brel par 'byung ba dang / stong pa nyid dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang /29—547

so so yang dag par rig pa nya)rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar gyi 98)'grib pa gang lags pa de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid (gem lags zhes zer/ rab 'byor ④gyis smras pa/tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / gzugs gang yin pa dang / gnyis su dbyer med pa gang yin pa dang / 'grib pa gang yin pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa gang yin pa dang / gnyis su dbyer med pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad ni ldan pa yang ma 45)yin/ mi ldan pa yang ma yin zhing /gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa ste/ 'di ltar mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /khams dang / skye mched dang /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang de bzhin te/ /de ltar na 'grib pa gang yin pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang yin pa dang / gnyis su dbyer med pa gang yin pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang peldan pa yang ma yin/ mi ldan pa yang ma yin zhing / gzugs med pa/ bstan tu med pa/ thogs pa med pa ste / 'di ltar mtshan nyid med par mtshan nyid gcig pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gzugs kyi 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin no/ /getshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams 29—548

dang / rnam par shes pa'i 'grib pa gang yin pa de ni rnam par shes pa ma yin no / /de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar gyi 'grib pa ①gang yin pa de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin no/ /shā ri'i bus smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor ci'i phyir/ khyod 'di skad du gang yang gzugs zhes bgyi ba de ni gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa ②lags so/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bgyi ba de ni gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa bulags so/ /gang yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bgyi ba'i bar de yang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i grangs su bgyis pa (galags so zhes smra/rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar skye ba med pa yang gzhan ma yin la gzugs kyang gzhan ma yin te/ skye ba med pa nyid kyang gzugs so/ /gzugs nyid kyang skye ba med pa'o/ /skye ba med pa yang gzhan ma yin la/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ skye ba med pa nyid kyang rnam par shes pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa nyid kyang skye ba med pa ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang yang gzugs zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa yin no/ /gang yang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa yin no/ /khams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams dang4 / stong pa nyid thams cad dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 29wa 549

'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin la/ skye ba med pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ skye ba med pa nyid kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang skye ba med pa ①ste/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu rnam grangs des na/ gang yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba de ni gnyis su med pa'i grangs su byas pa yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing chos de dag la de ltar nye bar rtog par bgyid pa de'i tshe shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ gzugs kyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ bdag gi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang /shed las skyes dang / shed bu dang / byed pa po dang / tshor ba po dang /shes pa po dang / mthong ba po'i skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ khams dang / skye mched rnams dang / rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i skye ba ma mchis pa ②mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i skye ba ma 29—550

mchis pa mthong lags so/ /de bzhin du shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyuskye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ nang stong pa nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar gyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ yang dag par ge spong ba dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs dang /byang chub kyi yan lag dang / lam dang / stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / gzungs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ so so'i skye bo'i skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams kyi skye ba ma mchis pa mthong lags so/ /shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du/ rgyun du zhugs pa dang / rgyun du zhugs pa'i chos rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang /phyir mi 'ong ba'i chos rnams dang / dgra bcom pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams dang /ci rang sangs rgyas dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 29—551
